_notes: Each workplace owns exact job slots; NPC assignment must use one of those slots.
bakedNpcTarget controls how many of the 200 deep NPCs are initially placed at that workplace.
Other occupied slots are lightweight/background people and can be promoted into fuller NPCs if they become relevant.
Family/Friend Web tier is separate from employment detail level.
Regional employer groups are nearby-county jobs for specialty occupations not naturally present in the immediate town.
Operating hours are business hours; individual NPC schedules come from the job master shift templates.
